description:
Find a CC0 HDRI sky on Poly Haven (or take an exact id) and import it into res://sky/ for environment light. Returns a ready summer_run_script snippet that wires it into the WorldEnvironment.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/import-hdri"}

assetId.description: Exact Poly Haven asset id (lowercase slug, e.g. 'kloppenheim_02'). Skips the search.

query.description: What kind of sky/environment, e.g. 'sunset beach', 'overcast field', 'studio'. Omit when assetId is given.

resolution.description: HDRI resolution. 2k (default) is right for most games; 4k for hero skies; 1k for quick blockouts.

name: summer_import_hdri
title: Import an HDRI sky
